newsitem.title: ESTONIA: STOCKS MIXED AS BOURSE WAITS FOR RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: STOCKS MIXED AS BOURSE WAITS FOR RESULTS.

text.p: * Total trade on the Estonian bourse on Wednesday was 36.3
million kroons versus Tuesday's 42.6 million kroons.
* The Talse index gained 0.06 percent to close at 276.07.
* Hoiupank was the most traded to turn over 15.2
million kroons to finish 0.25 kroons higher at 151.50 kroons.
* Hansapank saw 7.6 million kroons traded to gain
0.15 kroons to close at 147.15 kroons.
* 17 stocks traded, one steady, 11 up, five down.
(See index on stock exchange web site:
http://www.tse.ee/online/total.htm)
Shares were mixed on the Estonian stock exchange on Wednesday with strong interest in Hoiupank as investors wait for banking sector results.
Total trade on the main list was 31.1 million kroons with the Talse 0.06 percent higher at 276.23.
The market has slowed this week after surging last week on news of acquisitions and merger rumours.
"It was generally quiet with investors waiting for the banking results, but there was strong buying and selling interest in Hoiupank," one dealer said.
Buyers and sellers were matched in Hoiupank as its price rose by only 0.25 kroons to close at 151.50 kroons after registering trade of 15.2 million kroons.

"The interest in Hoiupank looked to be foreign as some larger than usual blocks were traded, but it seems that some investors are positioning themselves ahead of the bank's results," another dealer said.
Several banks have already said that they are considering revising their profit estimates after the release of their six-month results.
Hansapank closed at 147.35 kroons, up 0.20 kroons after turning over 7.6 million kroons.
The free market remained very slow with 5.2 million kroons turned over.
Rakvere meat plant was the most active with 1.8 million kroons traded to fall 0.25 kroons for a close of 13.50 kroons.
-- David Mardiste, Tallinn newsroom, +372 620 9202/1 reuters@reuters.ee
